body.p: After everything. Owns the gate boxes. A separate agent () runs the rubric and re-checks each "done when"; open items go under "Proposed". Done 2026-10-19 (), except the confirming full runs and fuzzing, deferred to the owner's machine: numbers at 02303a7 and 3b0812a, a new schema fuzz target, both step budgets judged fair, no driver reclassifies (the XSD driver's "not run" for an unsupported feature fixed), through component graphs and function pointers, NCName, whitespace and token helpers merged (fifteen files), an allocation-failure loop for schema.h, schema.h stable, five accepted designs out of Proposed.
